style.name: 墨与稿纸
style.prefix: Cinematic semi-realistic anime visual-novel illustration, muted ink-and-paper palette, aged manuscript paper cream tones and deep ink blacks, sparse vermilion-red accents, overcast mid-1990s Tokyo atmosphere, quiet oppressive stillness, tactile paper fibers, dry ink grain, subtle film grain.
style.suffix: High detail, atmospheric, somber restrained mood, key-visual quality, no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
globalConstraints: 人物只用背影、剪影或侧写，不出现可辨认正脸
日高邦彦在现实线不出现正脸或遗体
校园回忆只呈现安全日常或符号化空景，不呈现暴力、伤害或不当未成年人画面
猫之死不出画面，遗体和伤口不出画面
画面内不出现可读文字、品牌标识、水印或超出年代的设备
style.negative: vivid saturated colors, cheerful warmth, gore, violence in progress, visible corpse, identifiable face, celebrity likeness, modern smartphone, modern laptop, cyberpunk neon, glossy 3D render, readable text, logo, watermark

items.prompt: Empty book-lined private study viewed from the doorway at night; desk lamp, scattered unreadable manuscript sheets, moving boxes, paperweight and disconnected telephone cord as neutral still-life evidence; no people or deceased person; frame-within-frame composition with a calm lower dialogue area.

Empty garden and exterior of a Tokyo writer's house on an overcast evening; narrow path, still shrubs and relocation boxes faintly visible beyond a window; windless and gray; no people, animals or violence.

Empty modest apartment study of an adult children's author; desk, fountain pen, grid manuscript sheets, stacked books, cassette recorder, dark window and one cold desk lamp; manuscript overlay and ink-blot vignette; no person or reflection.
Empty after-hours Tokyo police investigative office; metal desks, paper files, corded telephones, desk lamps, analog clock and rain-gray windows; methodical and airless, period-accurate to 1996.

Empty Japanese detention-center interview room with thick partition glass, fixed stools, telephone handsets, metal door and blank institutional walls; symmetrical, fluorescent and emotionally austere.

Empty Japanese publishing-house reception room with low table, plain sofas, books with unreadable spines, ashtray, folders, frosted-glass door and overcast window; formal, still and faintly adversarial.

Empty period Japanese middle-school classroom in late overcast afternoon; rows of wooden desks, one slightly displaced chair and one closed school bag; symbolize remembered exclusion without people, conflict, damage or violence.

Empty period Japanese middle-school corridor with reverse-light perspective, closed classroom doors, shoe lockers and worn polished floor; symbolic and unresolved, never threatening; no minors or people.
Empty older Japanese residential school route at pale dawn; tiled roofs, utility poles, mist, worn pavement and distant school-gate geometry; limited faded-cherry haze, no people or modern vehicles.
Empty modest Japanese hospital room with one bed turned away, privacy curtain, bedside table, case folder and overcast window; pale, final and controlled; no patient, procedure or medical crisis.

Doorway dossier viewpoint into the study; exactly two adult investigators as small back silhouettes; desk-lamp evidence and moving boxes; deceased person completely absent; non-sensational procedural framing.

Restrained apartment-doorway arrest after the alibi collapses; exactly three adults, suspect centered with back to viewer and two investigators in side/back silhouettes; gray dawn, no struggle, weapon or visible face.
CRT television and VHS deck in a dim interview room; grainy analog footage shows one tiny adult back silhouette climbing a garden wall; no face, timestamp, action violence or modern screen.

Top-down forensic still life comparing handwritten notebooks with already published novels; abstract unreadable pages and sparse vermilion marks expose that the notebooks were copied afterward; no hands or people.

Dignified adult woman presents a marked-up novel and closed family file across a low reception-room table to an adult investigator; exactly two adults in side/back silhouette, calm but firm, no confrontation or faces.

A single old photograph lies strictly face-down on an archival folder beside white evidence gloves; only blank aged backing, curled corners and a paperclip are visible; the image and subject remain completely private.

Final hospital conversation between two adult men; patient sits facing away and detective stands at respectful distance in side/back silhouette; both faces hidden, no medical crisis, pale overcast finality.

Exactly two Japanese middle-school boys safely walking to school side by side in an older neighborhood, shown from behind at respectful middle distance; faded-cherry dawn, no faces, conflict, distress or inappropriate depiction.
Fountain pen beside one blank manuscript sheet carrying only an abstract black paw-print ink symbol; the cat is never shown; one tiny vermilion editorial slash.
Closed period travel suitcase with a blank luggage tag and folded unmarked map; no flags, destination text or people.
Heavy round desk paperweight beside a coiled disconnected landline telephone cord, arranged as neutral nonviolent evidence.
Stack of unreadable manuscript pages beside a period output tray and abstract analog desk clock; no legible numerals or writing.
Unreadable typed manuscript page with blank margin, bookmark and red proofreader pencil, suggesting deliberate reader awareness without words.
Black VHS cassette and plain unmarked case with an abstract analog scan-noise band and one tiny vermilion record dot.
Two closed handwritten notebooks tied with dark string beside one plain published book, all covers blank, with a tiny comparison mark.
Small framed photograph turned fully face-down so only its aged cardboard back and stand appear, beside a dried neutral flower; no image or person visible.
Carefully folded vintage kitchen apron in a shallow archive box, rendered as respectful neutral evidence.
Sealed period medical-document envelope with only an abstract hospital cross beside an unlabeled medicine bottle; no patient or readable text.
Closed literary novel with a fully blank worn cover, archival complaint folder and vermilion bookmark, suggesting contested authorship without words.
Layered manuscript sheets with abstract unreadable ink bands and visibly conflicting page order, crossed by sparse vermilion proofreader lines.
Two simple vintage Japanese school bags side by side at the start of a lightly sketched residential path; safe everyday symbolism and limited faded-cherry dawn haze.
Abstract three-tier pyramid assembled from blank gray school desk nameplates, upper tier casting shadow over lower tiers; no names or figures.
Old photograph placed strictly face-down, showing only blank aged backing, curled corners and one paperclip; reveal absolutely no image or subject.
Sealed plain archive envelope held shut by dark ribbon beside a blank closed novel, symbolizing a secret deliberately protected.
Worn wooden teacher's pointer and one piece of white chalk laid across a blank blackboard eraser; period-appropriate, nonviolent and without students.
Deep black circular ink well with one irregular black drop and a blank evidence label turned face-down; a sparse vermilion ring suggests nameless malice without weapons or violent imagery.

Stack of aged manuscript sheets on a dark writer's desk; top page carries one heavy vermilion proofreading slash over a blank field, beside a capped fountain pen, closed case folder and ink well; still life only, with central negative space for HTML title overlay.
